title: acs state fragment for /acs:docs-sync
description: What THIS skill records: the `states` keys it owns and, when it completes in more than one way, its closed `outcome` vocabulary. The envelope is validated centrally by step-state.schema.json; this fragment is why adding a skill is a directory rather than an edit to a central schema (§4.4).

docs_committed.description: Repo-relative paths of every doc file docs-sync itself changed (the union over every doc area's and the integration pass's doc-updater report), mirroring /code's docs_updated naming.

commits.description: Short SHA + message of each additional commit docs-sync made on the ticket branch.

guard_denials.description: Derived by the post-hook when the file-map guard denied a write; never written by the skill.
